```python
        current = val
        df.loc[i, 'Format'] = current

        df.loc[i, 'Format'] = current

br['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(br['Year'], errors='coerce')
br = br.dropna(subset=['Year'])
br_sorted = br.sort_values('Year')
print('Blu-Ray block preview:\n', br_sorted[['Title','Year']].to_string(index=False))
oldest_row = br_sorted.iloc[0]
print('Oldest Blu-Ray Title:', oldest_row['Title'])
```

```python
from openpyxl import load_workbook
fp = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

# Find the row where 'Title' header exists
# Then scan down Title column to capture 'Blu-Ray' block items and their Year from the Year column
# Header is likely on row 2; data starts at row 3
rows = list(s.iter_rows(values_only=True))
# Identify the indices for columns by header row
hdr_idx = None
for i, r in enumerate(rows):
    if r and 'Title' in r:
        hdr_idx = i
        break
colmap = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(rows[hdr_idx])}
blu_start = None
entries = []
for r in rows[hdr_idx+1:]:
    title = r[colmap['Title']]
    if title == 'Blu-Ray':
        blu_start = True
        continue
    if title in ('DVD','VHS','CD','Digital','Laserdisc') and blu_start:
        # End of Blu-Ray block
        break
    if blu_start and title:
        year = r[colmap['Year']]
        entries.append((title, year))
# Select earliest
entries_clean = [(t, y) for t, y in entries if isinstance(y, (int, float))]
oldest = sorted(entries_clean, key=lambda x: x[1])[0][0] if entries_clean else None
print('Openpyxl detected oldest Blu-Ray title:', oldest)
```

```python
import pandas as pd
import re
fp = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(fp, skiprows=2)

# forward-fill Format
cur=None; df['Format']=None
for i, t in enumerate(df['Title'].astype(str)):
    v=t.strip()
    if v in formats:
        cur=v
        df.loc[i,'Format']=cur
    else:
        df.loc[i,'Format']=cur

# Normalize titles
def norm(s):
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 ]+", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s

df['Title_norm'] = df['Title'].astype(str).apply(norm)
df['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
# Titles that appear in Blu-Ray (normalized)
br_norm_set = set(df[(df['Format']=='Blu-Ray') & (~df['Title'].isin(list(formats)))]['Title_norm'].dropna())
min_year_by_norm_title = df.groupby('Title_norm')['Year_num'].min().dropna()
# Restrict to Blu-Ray titles by normalized name
cand = min_year_by_norm_title[min_year_by_norm_title.index.isin(br_norm_set)]
res = cand.sort_values().index[0] if not cand.empty else None
# Map back to original casing using first occurrence
orig = df[df['Title_norm']==res]['Title'].iloc[0] if res else None
print('Normalized cross-format result:', orig)
```

```python
import pandas as pd
import re
fp = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

        df.loc[i,'Format']=cur
    else:
        df.loc[i,'Format']=cur

def franchise(s):
    parts=re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", s)

res=fr_min[fr_min.index.isin(br_fr)].sort_values().index[0]
choice=df[df['fr']==res]['Title'].iloc[0]
print('Franchise-level earliest among Blu-Ray franchises:', choice)
```
